package service

import (
	"database/sql"
)

// scenario for service_method_returns_gorm_db_or_sql_rows: Services that leak ORM or driver primitives upward instead of returning business results.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.
type ReportService struct {
	db *sql.DB
}

func NewReportService(db *sql.DB) *ReportService {
	return &ReportService{db: db}
}

func (s *ReportService) Query() (*sql.Rows, error) {
	rows, err := s.db.Query("SELECT id, name, revenue FROM accounts WHERE active = true")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return rows, nil
}

func (s *ReportService) FetchRaw(dbName string) *sql.DB {
	if dbName == "readonly" {
		return s.db
	}
	return s.db
}
